overall: The AG found the April 30 afternoon meeting notice ("FY 15 Budget discussion") adequately specific and did not violate the Open Meeting Law. It declined the G.L. c. 71 § 38N claim and issued an unprompted reminder about member emails, with no order.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the April 30 3:30 PM meeting notice, listing only 'FY 15 Budget discussion', was too vague about the topics discussed.
allegations.key_passage: While it may have been helpful for the Chair to include additional details in the notice about specific budget items he anticipated discussing, as written the topic was sufficient to inform the public that the Committee would be discussing the entire FY 15 school budget.

allegations.summary: Complaint also alleged possible violation of G.L. c. 71, § 38N, which is outside the Open Meeting Law.
allegations.key_passage: Because our review concerns only compliance with the Open Meeting Law, we decline to review allegations regarding the Committee's compliance with G.L. c. 71, § 38N.

allegations.summary: Not raised by complainant; AG itself noted concern about member emails discussing budget and reminded the committee of email limits, making no violation finding.
allegations.key_passage: We remind the Committee that communications over email regarding Committee business between and among members of the Committee must be limited to the distribution of a meeting agenda, scheduling information or the distribution of reports or documents to be discussed at a meeting.
